description: Add comprehensive tests for renderEntryResult covering all 5 statuses in tests/unit/cli/entry-render.test.ts
steps: 1. Create tests/unit/cli/entry-render.test.ts following the pattern from tests/unit/scan/scan-cli.test.ts and tests/unit/cli/cli.test.ts.

2. Test READY status: Create a temp repo with knowledge records that produce a READY result (like cli.test.ts repositoryFixture). Assert stdout contains checkmark, question text, behavior slice subject, fact text with file paths and confidence badges. Assert empty categories are omitted.

3. Test KNOWLEDGE_CANDIDATES status: Set up a repo with entity-only records (no flow) so query produces candidates. Assert stdout contains question mark symbol, candidate recordId, subject, confidence, and next action commands with --candidate and --reject-candidates.
4. Test KNOWLEDGE_NOT_FOUND status: Use --reject-candidates with an unrelated question against a repo with records. Assert stdout contains X mark, question, and acquisition guidance commands.

5. Test KNOWLEDGE_STALE status: Set up a repo with records, modify the source file to make evidence stale, then run entry. Assert stdout contains warning symbol, flowRecordId, stale issue info, and next action guidance.
6. Test KNOWLEDGE_UNKNOWN status: Set up a repo with records that have evidence pointing to non-existent paths. Assert stdout contains warning symbol and unknown issue info.
7. Test --json flag: Run entry with --json and assert stdout is undefined (JSON mode preserved).
8. Test that confidence badge logic works: facts with all CONFIRMED claims show [CONFIRMED], facts with an INFERRED claim show [INFERRED], facts with UNKNOWN show [UNKNOWN].
acceptance_criteria: tests/unit/cli/entry-render.test.ts exists with tests for all 5 statuses
Tests verify actual rendered content (symbols, key text fragments, structure)
Full test suite still passes: npm test
